newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH INSURER PZU CAPITAL INCREASE APPROVED.
newsitem.headline: POLISH INSURER PZU CAPITAL INCREASE APPROVED.

text.p: The treasury ministry has approved a share capital increase for Poland's largest insurer, state-owned PZU SA, prior to the company's full privatisation, the ministry's spokesman said on Wednesday.

Zbigniew Ostrowski said the treasury minister at a PZU general shareholders meeting on Tuesday decided that the firm's capital would be increased by between 19.9 and 34 percent through a new share issue to a group of investors.

PZU's management will now draft a list of potential investors and the ministry will later approve them and, after consulations with a privatisation adviser, set the terms of the sale which should be done as soon as possible, Ostrowski said.
"The general shareholders meeting has decided on PZU's capital increase through a news share issue ex-rights," Ostrowski told Reuters.

"(PZU) management has been obliged to prepare a list of investors including no less than 20 (investors) and not more than 300, including at least five entities carrying out insurance operations," he added.
PZU spokesman Marek Maszek said the new share issue must bring at least 600 million zlotys needed to secure mandatory safety ratios. "We hope it will bring more," he told Reuters.
PZU's share capital is now 60.5 million zlotys.
The government decided last week that PZU, which controls 65 percent of Poland's non-life insurance market and 80 percent of the life market, would be fully privatised next year.
PZU's management would like the privatisation, in which the treasury's stake in the company would drop to below 50 percent, to take the form of a public offer.

The opposition has criticised PZU's privatisation plans for allegedlly including a plot by PZU's management and some cabinet members to sell a large stake in the company cheaply to selected domestic investors.
But deputy fianance minister Karol Szwarc suggested this year's new share issue could go to foreign investors.
He told the Rzeczposolita daily in its Wednesday edition that PZU would benefit from capital links with West European and U.S. investors.
PZU's Maszek confirmed that the company was in talks with serious Western investors on selling them a stake.
